name: Blink Dog
languages: understands Sylvan but can't speak it

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.

notes: A blink dog takes its name from its ability to blink in and out of existence, a talent it uses to aid its attacks and to avoid harm.
